Estonian Defence Minister Resigns Over India-Linked Arms Deal for Ukraine

Estonia's Defence Minister Hanno Pevkur has resigned following a controversy over a €70 million (approximately ₹770 crore) arms deal intended to supply artillery shells to Ukraine. The deal involved an Indian company that reportedly has no prior track record in manufacturing shells. The funds for the procurement were sourced from the European Union. The resignation was reported by multiple outlets, highlighting the Indian firm's central role in the scandal.
